class.name: StreamingAssetsExportPlugin
class.brief_description: Built-in export plugin that ships the streaming assets folder unchanged with an export.
class.description: The editor registers one instance of this export plugin. It is active when the project setting [code]filesystem/streaming_assets/enabled[/code] is [code]true[/code], and handles the folder set in [code]filesystem/streaming_assets/source_folder[/code] (default [code]"res://streaming_assets"[/code]): - Every file below the folder is skipped by the regular export, together with its [code].import[/code] remap and its imported artifacts. The files are never converted. - [b]External[/b] (Windows and Linux/BSD, mode [code]raw[/code]): after the export, the folder is copied unchanged to [code]filesystem/streaming_assets/target_folder[/code] (default [code]"{exe_name}_Data/StreamingAssets"[/code]), relative to the folder of the exported executable or, for "Export PCK/ZIP only", of the [code].pck[/code]. A previous copy is removed first. [code]{exe_name}[/code] is replaced by the base name of the export file. - [b]Bundle[/b] (macOS, iOS and visionOS, mode [code]raw[/code], also for [code].zip[/code], [code].dmg[/code] and [code].pkg[/code] exports): every file is registered with [method EditorExportPlugin.add_bundle_resource], so the exporter copies the folder to [code]filesystem/streaming_assets/target_folder[/code] inside the bundle resources ([code]Contents/Resources[/code] on macOS, the bundle root on iOS and visionOS) before the app is signed. [code]{exe_name}[/code] is the name of the app bundle: the base name of the export file for [code].app[/code] exports and on iOS and visionOS, and the application name ([member ProjectSettings.application/config/name]) for the other macOS formats. - [b]Embed[/b] (Android, Web, Windows and Linux/BSD [code].zip[/code] exports, and any other platform, with [code]filesystem/streaming_assets/fallback[/code] set to [code]embed[/code]): the files are added unchanged to the main pack at their [code]res://[/code] paths. - [b]None[/b] (the same platforms, with the fallback set to [code]none[/code]): the files are not shipped. Files and folders whose name starts with [code].[/code] (such as [code].gdignore[/code]), [code]*.import[/code] and [code]*.uid[/code] files, and symbolic links to folders are never shipped. The settings are read per export preset, so feature tag overrides such as [code]filesystem/streaming_assets/fallback.web[/code] apply. When a setting does not exist, its default is used. The [code]pack[/code] mode is not available yet: the folder is then exported in [code]raw[/code] mode and a warning is shown. While [method PCKPackageExporter.is_building] returns [code]true[/code], the plugin does nothing: a pack built from a [PCKPackage] description holds the files of the description only, so the folder is neither embedded into it nor copied next to it. The export log lists the number of files and their total size, and the chosen placement. The static helpers below expose the rules the plugin uses, for example to check a project before exporting it: [codeblocks] [gdscript] var files = StreamingAssetsExportPlugin.collect_files("res://streaming_assets") var target = StreamingAssetsExportPlugin.expand_template("{exe_name}_Data/StreamingAssets", "MyGame") print(files.size(), " files go to ", target) # MyGame_Data/StreamingAssets [/gdscript] [csharp] string[] files = StreamingAssetsExportPlugin.CollectFiles("res://streaming_assets"); string target = StreamingAssetsExportPlugin.ExpandTemplate("{exe_name}_Data/StreamingAssets", "MyGame"); GD.Print(files.Length, " files go to ", target); // MyGame_Data/StreamingAssets [/csharp] [/codeblocks] [b]Note:[/b] This class is only available in editor builds. It cannot be instantiated from scripts.

method.name: collect_files
method.description: Returns the paths of all files below [param folder] that the plugin ships, relative to [param folder] and sorted. Subfolders are walked recursively. Entries for which [method is_file_excluded] returns [code]true[/code], hidden entries and symbolic links to folders are left out. [param folder] can be a [code]res://[/code] path or an absolute path. Returns an empty array if the folder does not exist.

method.name: expand_template
method.description: Expands the placeholders in [param template] with [method StreamingAssetsServer.expand_template], the same helper the runtime uses to find the folder: [code]{exe_name}[/code], [code]{app_name}[/code] and [code]{version}[/code]. Other placeholders are left unchanged. The plugin passes the base name of the export file without its extension, for example [code]"MyGame"[/code] for [code]MyGame.exe[/code].

method.name: is_file_excluded
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if a file or folder with the name [param name] is never shipped: empty names, names that start with [code].[/code], and names that end with [code].import[/code] or [code].uid[/code].

method.name: is_path_in_folder
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if [param path] is [param folder] itself or lies below it. Both paths are simplified first, and a trailing slash of [param folder] is ignored. A bare prefix such as [code]"res://"[/code] or an empty [param folder] never matches. The plugin uses this to skip the files of the source folder.

method.name: is_valid_target_folder
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if [param folder] can be used as the expanded target folder: it must be relative and not empty, and none of its components may be empty, [code].[/code], [code]..[/code] or contain a placeholder brace or a [code]:[/code]. Backslashes count as slashes, and a trailing slash is allowed. The plugin refuses an invalid target, because it removes the old content of the target before copying.

method.name: resolve_placement
method.description: Returns where the plugin puts the streaming assets for an export with the given [param features] (the export features of the preset) to [param export_path]. Returns [constant PLACEMENT_BUNDLE] if [param features] contains [code]"macos"[/code], [code]"ios"[/code] or [code]"visionos"[/code]. Returns [constant PLACEMENT_EXTERNAL] if [param features] contains [code]"pc"[/code] and [param export_path] does not end with [code].zip[/code]. Otherwise returns [constant PLACEMENT_NONE] if [param fallback] is [constant FALLBACK_NONE], and [constant PLACEMENT_EMBED] if not.

constants.constant: The files are copied unchanged and read at runtime through [code]streaming://[/code]. Value [code]raw[/code] of [code]filesystem/streaming_assets/mode[/code].
The folder is exported as a second pack. Value [code]pack[/code] of [code]filesystem/streaming_assets/mode[/code]. Not available yet: the plugin exports the folder in [constant MODE_RAW] instead.
On platforms without an external folder, the files are embedded unchanged into the main pack. Value [code]embed[/code] of [code]filesystem/streaming_assets/fallback[/code].
On platforms without an external folder, the files are not shipped. Value [code]none[/code] of [code]filesystem/streaming_assets/fallback[/code].
The folder is copied next to the export after it was written.
The files are embedded unchanged into the main pack at their [code]res://[/code] paths.
The files are left out of the export.
The files are copied into the resources of the app bundle (macOS, iOS, visionOS) before it is signed.
